description: Adds or removes a base template on a template item. Removing one takes its fields off every item built from the template, along with their values.

action.description: Whether to add the base template or remove it.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

id.description: The ID of the template item. Supply this or path.

path.description: The path of the template item. Supply this or id.

template.description: The path of the template item to add or remove as a base template.

name: common-set-base-template
